Sophie Tran: Quick repro: HF->Redwood conversion for model open-chat-lite results in truncated streaming when output contains consecutive EOS tokens. Repro curl below.

Sophie Tran: ```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"open-chat-lite\",\"input\":\"Tell me a story\",\"stream\":true, \"stop\":[\"</s>\"]}'
```

Kevin Liu: Do token ids actually include two eos back-to-back? Could tokenizer be collapsing? 

Sophie Tran: Raw token stream: ids [3456, 512, 2, 2], pieces [\"end\",\"</s>\",\"</s>\"]. Streaming emits chunk at first 2 and runtime stop handler cuts the stream before second 2 arrives.

Maria R.: Convert script often maps sep_token_id == eos_token_id when HF uses combined tokens. Runtime has a trim_consecutive_eos path that collapses duplicates. If client stop-match is eager it will stop at earliest match.

Josh B.: Two issues: (1) conversion/config may declare duplicate special tokens in chat_template, (2) client stop matching prefers earliest prefix match. Need to handle multi-token stops.

Sophie Tran: Current converted config snippet:

Sophie Tran: ```
\"config.json\": {
  \"eos_token_id\": 2,
  \"sep_token_id\": 2,
  \"pad_token_id\": 0,
  \"chat_template\": {
    \"system\":\"<|system|>\",
    \"user\":\"<|user|>\",
    \"assistant\":\"<|assistant|>\"
  }
}
```

Maria R.: Proposal: conversion should canonicalize special tokens (choose single sentinel if ids equal), strip duplicate trailing sentinels in chat templates, and write an explicit manifest field \"stop_token_ids\" mapping stop strings to token sequences.

Josh B.: Runtime change: buffer emitted tokens until a full stop-token sequence is matched (configurable flag \"buffer_until_full_stop\"). Also client SDK: prefer longest-match for stop sequences.

infra-bot: CI: model-conversion-tests/open-chat-lite FAILED - regression: streaming-multi-eos

Sophie Tran: I\u2019ll open PR to convert script: collapse duplicate specials, add unit test where chat template ends with \"</s></s>\", and set buffer_until_full_stop=true in new model manifest. Also link reproducer logs.

Kevin Liu: after PR lands i\'ll run dedicated CI with quantized kernels — quant can shift tokenization boundaries so good to validate.

Maria R.: Add integration test with stop: [\"</s>\"] and synthetic prompt that emits \"</s></s>\". Assert client sees complete token sequence and stop callback fired only after full match.

Josh B.: I\'ll follow up with client SDK patch tomorrow to implement longest stop match. :thumbsup:

Sophie Tran: Thanks all, PR incoming. Putting links to repro and CI traces in PR description.
